nom: The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Masque Clarifying Charcoal & Clay Mask for Blemish Prone Skin

avis.texte: I've been wearing makeup as a requirement for my job and wanted something to keep my pores clean and face fresh. I love this! I wear it 10-15 minutes twice a week at night. There is a small tingle, especially if your face is sensitive but it doesn't last long and your face feels clean after washing it off. Please wear sunscreen as it makes your skin sensitive to the sun after using.

SENSITIVE, PEELING, OR COMPROMISED SKIN." (compromised meaning damaged/weakened skin barrier/current issues, etc.) i think if you are just breaking out then it should be fine. but if you have sensitive skin, dont use. the reviews match up for the people that said they have sensitive skin and it irritated it.

For some reason this product didn't agree with my skin. I've been using SA since I was a teenager (I'm in my 40's). I do manual exfoliation, use BHA and AHA regularly. I thought buying this would be my typical experience. I didn't have burning or stinging like some people but when I took the mask off my face was bright red in the exact place the mask was. I've never had that much of a reaction from kaolin or SA. I now have a calming mask on in the hopes to calm the inflammation. Dissappointed.

I've been using The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Masque for over 5 years, and it never disappoints! It does wonders for keeping my skin clear and smooth, especially when I pair it with the Kate Somerville Exfoliator. The charcoal and clay formula really draws out impurities without over-drying, leaving my skin refreshed and balanced. Truly a must-have for anyone dealing with blemishes!

avis.titre: Be careful washing down the drain
avis.texte: I liked this product it made my skin feel smooth (although some minor irritation immediately after washing off). That said I probably will not be purchasing again. This completely clogged my drain. Maybe I am dumb or something, but I did not realize rinsing this off in the sink could cause that. The instructions just say to rinse with lukewarm water so i dont really know how else you would take this off.

This is the holy grail for getting rid of those stubborn blackheads around your nose. Ive been using this for years now and I cant get enough! I really recommend this for all skin types—especially oily because this mask sucks up all that extra oil & dirt and leaves your skin feeling clean and soft. My only suggestion is putting on a more hydrating moisturizer afterwards.
This product makes your skin feel baby butt soft! Lol... I wish I had found this company years ago!
The consistency of this product is nice, but I'm not really sure it really does anything for the skin. It's just ok.

avis.titre: Makes my face feel so clean
avis.texte: Omg I love this!! It makes my skin feel soooo clean and its so refreshing when put on. The color makes it easy to appy and the price is great. Will definitely buy again

Honestly, I have been using this mask for years and I can say it is truly my go to. I only use it once a week but that is plenty, because it does wonders to my skin. I have really sensitive skin, and this mask has never irritated my skin. It calms it down and makes it glow. It is awesome!

avis.titre: Going to Be a Staple for Me
avis.texte: I was having a little breakout and this really helped clear it up. Did it right before bed and used my other regular serums and saw results overnight.
I use this once a week, on my self care Sunday and it leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed.
I purchase this product a month ago and i feel like it doesnt work. If anything, there was minimal change.
I was looking for a discontinued Loreal product. And this perfectly filled in the missing link in my face routine.
Overall a great product! I use this twice a week,which has cleared a good amount of my acne or reduced the appearance of it.

100% pleased with this product. Using twice a week has faded dark spots from my face. Definitely has tingling feeling when applied but doesn't cause any damage. My teenager though said they felt it was slightly burning on his face. I would think better suited for mature skin than delicate young skin.
I love how my face feels after using this every single time. I look forward to taking the extra time to use this because it feels like it actually is working and that makes a difference!

I've been using this mask for around 4 years now and I LOVE IT. I have blackheads and oily skin and this helps immensely. My skin feels soft and not overstripped after i use it. Great price point as well. I do ulta sold the bigger size as well.

I have oily and acne prone skin and this was pretty good. I had noticed that my pores were very noticeable so I was looking for something to minimize them and had come across this, I read a few reviews. Most where saying that it dried out there skin (for me it doesn't but i think the people saying this probably have dry, sensitive, not really oily skin. Which I think that might be the reasoning) But I personally like this. I have only used it once and my pores weren't bumpy and showing as much and my skin felt smooth. I only used product on my nose (and upper part of cheek NEAR my under eye, the skin above upper lip, and my chin) I will be reviewing again after second use. Before I tried it on my face I did a spot test ( i put a small amount on the back side of my arm and left it for 10 minutes, i didnt see a bad reaction to it so i did it on my face for 10 minutes like the instructions said). byee
I love this mask! It doesn't dry out my skin and it makes my face glow!

I read reviews saying that it was too harsh and bought it anyway. It's too harsh and turns my sensitive skin all red. I think this could be good to just use in the T zone, where my pores get clogged. Don't use if you have sensitive skin.

I have been using this for a few years now and this has been my go to mask when I start to break out. It removed everything and allows my face to have a fresh start. I have sensitive skin so I will say it can sting if you leave it on for to long. My max time is 6-7 min. But I do recommend this

Je l'ai essayé 3-4 fois en le laissant 5 minutes sur mon visage. Malheureusement, je sens ma bouche s'engourdir et ma peau qui chauffe après environ 2-3 minutes. Toutefois, j'aime bien la texture du produit et je vois ma peau plus éclaircit lorsque je le rince.

Do not apply to wet skin & you wont have burning or discomfort. I let my face dry 10-15 minutes after cleansing before applying . Cleared my pores & congestion in one application, and i have battled this congestion on my chin for ages.

Holy moly, this stuff is amazing! I read all the negative reviews, product too thick, dries too fast etc. It does dry pretty quick, but I was generous with the application and it helped with that. I did my face a section at a time, I have no idea what the other people were having, but it came out of the bottle just fine. I could feel the difference when I was rinsing it off, my face felt SO SMOOTH, and my pores are visibly clearer. all the little back dots on my nose? GONE. The congestion on my chin? Ha! What congestion?! There was zero burning or irritation, I have normal/dry skin. I will absolutely be ordering this again, it works beautifully! I was sure to set a timer when I applied it, first for 5 minutes, just to be safe. No tingling or burning, nothing after 5 minutes, so I set it for another 5, paying close attention for any signs of irritation, and nothing. As soon as it gets wet, it rinsed off no problem. Didn't leave any trace in my white sink, didn't stain my (natural unpolished) nails or my blonde hair (got a little in my baby hairs at the temples). Overall I'm extremely happy with my purchase. FYI: I followed with niacinamide toner, hyaluronic acid, peptide serum, 10% niacinamide serum, and 1% retinol in plum seed oil, none of which caused any irritation at any point.

Okay I was a little sceptical about this one as I like a grainy exfoliant like a Glycolic Scrub, but this product is AMAZING!!! I used it 2 nights ago and my skin still feels so smooth and decongested, I'm actually so surprised. Have a bit of hormonal acne going on at the moment so my skin has been feeling greasy and gross. Even my pores look way smaller. Putting my moisturiser on ever since has been soo satisfying because there's been such a decrease in texture in ONE USE! I can't wait to see what this does for my skin in a few months time. I don't go out of my way to review things unless I love them, so this is a huge win for me. Also bought with the gel cleanser, HA moisturiser, retinoid serum and suspension vit C to cycle through. I have the squaline cleanser from a past purchase, but I only use it for breaking down makeup and don't like it as an every day cleanser. The only thing I don't absolutely love about these products is the smell, but on the flip I like that they're not unnecessarily perfumed. Ii digress, 11/10, huge fan of this product!!
I use this as a mask for my nose! Makes the product last longer and in my opinion is the most effective spot for it. Amazing for pores!!

avis.titre: Great product but needs new packaging
avis.texte: I have used for six months and my skin is significantly less congested. Made a real difference to the frequency of my nodular and other forms of acne. However, so much of the product is left in the tube and have to cut it open. Repackage in a pot please!
I use this ln my nose where my pores tend tl clog and get crusty and this product is an instant fix. I love it!
I put it on and left it on for eight minutes, I took it off, and my face was redder than a tomato!! my face is burning and stinging! Do not buy save your money!!

I absolutely love this product. It gets rid of all of the little blackheads on my nose and it clears up my acne like a dream. It does burn a little bit so if you have extremely sensitive skin, I probably wouldn't recommend this to you.

avis.titre: Love this for my acne prone skin!!!
avis.texte: I purchased this about 2 months ago and I use it every week on Sundays and Wednesdays, and let me tell you my acne has gone down so much. This product has really helped limit my acne and I noticed results after the first 2 weeks. I am definitely going to repurchase this. In the directions it says to use all over face but I mainly apply it only to the areas where I have a lot of acne, especially because this product is VERY drying. But I usually apply it right after I shower, then I rinse it, and I put on my moisturizer and my skin feels so smooth and my acne bumps start to fade. This product is AMAZING!

After trying this the first time my skin felt so smooth and seemed clearer, im sure it will only improve, I did buy it for my blackheads. I also have sensitive skin so I will only use once a week, I had no reaction.

I've probably gone over 3 or 4 before I make this review. First time I used it I was kind of bummed because my skin got tingly and after mask I got red patches all over my face, but after maybe ten minutes they were gone and my skin felt actually great and refreshed. Can't recommend enough. It makes my skin SHINE and it looks so so good, it is like it declutters my pores and removes the gunk and dirt and leaves your skin smooth, brilliant and ready to soak in all the nutrients I apply later. Absolutely love it. I was glad they came up with the 100ml tube.

I love this Ordinary Salicylic Acid Masque. I got tired of squeezing the pores on my nose to get rid of all the gunk that accumulates in them. So I saw a review of their product by The Doctors on YouTube. I've been using it for two months and have really noticed a difference. My pores are smaller and no more gunk. The price makes it affordable as well.

I originally bought this for my boyfriend but ended up keeping it for myself. This stuff is amazing! I had white heads that were coming in and already formed. It worked like magic removing them. I shared and it worked with him too!
This is my go-to when I'm having a breakout. The color is weird but it works great

avis.titre: Made me feel so much better about my skin!
avis.texte: I have had issues for several months with breakouts around a certain time of the month. It's been so frustrating, as I'm 40! I purchased this product and I've used it anytime I've seen pimples coming on (or full on), and they've disappeared so quickly. I use it only on the areas where the breakout is coming on, as I don't want to dry out other areas. It sounds odd, but this product has made me feel so much better about my skin!

avis.titre: A M A Z I N G
avis.texte: I've been using the ordinary brand for about 3 years now, and through time I have advanced from beginners skin care to now advanced. I spend a lot of money on skincare products and I really can say, I see the most results with this brand. And you literally can't beat their prices. It's sensible and affordable. I WANT TO MAKE A PSA FOR ANY OF YOU THAT MAY BE NEW TO USING THINGS LIKE THIS!!! **Go to the ordinary's actual website, search your product, and read thoroughly their instructions. They are far more detailed and helpful!** Back to my review though! I have used this about 6x now in the past 3 weeks, and I LOVE THIS MASK! I have always been a fan of a good clay mask, but this one is awesome. It is refreshing, and it does every single thing that it reads. Stop buying those 50….70 dollar products and get yourself started on the ordinary. There's 100% no way you won't love it.
I use it once a week, great as spot treatment, as it helps dry pimples.

avis.titre: Good for Price and isn't irritating
avis.texte: I can sensitive acne prone skin so I am sensitive on which face masks to put on my face. This is one of the first masks in a long time that doesnt make my skin inflamed or so red.

Literally the only face masque that helps my skin with oil control without drying me out completely. I use it once a week, then use ceraVe SA cleanser and a light moisturizer twice daily. Within a month of this my skin went to being GREASY by 3-4pm, to perfectly dry all day. Also seems to help a bit with acne. You defs have to get in a routine of using it 1-2 times a week for it to work, so don't expect instant results, but that's honestly how it is with any product. Bought the 10oz around July 2023 and am just starting to run out in December! 100% putting the 20oz bottle on my Christmas list :)
This stuff is sooooo good. Smoothing, softenjng, clears pores, eases texture. Ill forever keep this in my skincare lineup. Burns a lil at first but goes away after a min or two.

avis.titre: Great product - not so great packaging
avis.texte: I try to avoid buying the 50 mL products and I'll be buying the 100 mL next time. The tube is so stiff that I have to cut the end of it off to get the remaining product out. Photo shows how much was still in the tube after I could no longer squeeze any out.

This mask can be compared to expensive name brands and even works better than a lot. Contains salicylic acid which is the only thing that fights my acne. Doesnt burm, irritate or dry me out as long as you follow directions and moisturize. Works fast and comes off easily. Pretty much the only face mask I use or buy now for acne.

I've used face masks before but never this type of mask. It smells strongly but dries fast when applied. I did patch test it on my arm (as recommended) before applying it to my face. It stays on for 10 minutes and then you rinse it off. It can be messy when rinsing off but I haven't noticed it staining my sink or towels. The first time I used this I had some painful acne forming. The next day those zits had white heads & weren't as painful. Same when I used it a second time. It brought zits to the surface & formed whiteheads that I'd been struggling with for weeks.
I just started using this product and it's working so well!!! My skin feels amazing!! Definitely recommend!

I purchased this product after reading an article that claims it will minimize your pores. I've used the Biore pore strips with some success. However, after using this for two weeks, it's definitely better in reducing larger pores on your nose and helping remove gunk and blackheads. I will definitely buy again.

This mask leaves my skin feeling baby smooth and free of impurities. I see an immediate improvement in my skin texture and town when I use this. I was worried it would d try my skin out, but when I follow this mask with my normal moisturizer my skin looks absolutely radiant.
ive been using this for a few weeks and omg. it works so well like literally i see results right after i wash it off. 10/10 worth the $

I absoluetly love this mask, i use it about once a week and only apply it to my oily areas & breakouts. It almost always clears my breakouts overnight! I have sensitive skin and it can be left a little red after washing this off, but i apply my moisturizer after rinsing and the redness is always gone by morning.

I have had trouble with blackheads on my nose for years. But finally have found the Ordinary Salicylic Mask honest has made a big difference virtually no blackheads anymore. BUT I use the salicylic mask with Epiduo Forte which I apply every night and use the ordinary mask twice a week. Epiduo Forte (adapalene + benzoyl peroxide) is only available in Australia with a prescription but do yourself a favour and go to your doctor for a script. This combination is the best for those pesky blackheads it has done wonders for my skin. I really never thought I would ever get rid of my blackheads on my nose so I am sharing because I know how annoying it is, it really affects your confidence when you have a skin condition that bothers you greatly.

This product changed mt skin, i tried it to look aesthetic but ended up having my skin fell SO SOFT and during week so no acne. I use it once a week but if i dont see a problem with my skin i just leave it on my shelf. When i see a pimple i put a dot on it and go to sleep and its like a snall red bump that concealer can hide. So good and has lasted me a year! I recommend especially if you have stress acne!
I use this mask at night and my skin is smooth and looking fresh by the morning. I just wish it wasn't so difficult to squeeze out

I just used it today along with everything else I was recommended and I really Iiked it. -it was a thick creamy smooth texture when allying - on my skin (yours can react differently) it tingled at first (almost like it was going to start to burn) but then it cooled down after a few minutes. - once dried, it tightened on my skin (like all masks do) - after 10 min it came off easy and went back to a creamy smooth texture when I was washing it off. - once its all off my skin felt like I just splashed cold water on it so it feel refreshing for a little while (are supposed to wash off with warm water btw) and my nose especially felt less textured and soft. All and all the instructions were very straightforward and helpful on the back and it's super easy to use after washing and drying my face.
absolute must have in my skincare routine weekly, leaves my skin feeling clean and renewed

this stuff is amazing. i don't have acne, but it really puts an extra shine to my complexion. i tried another mask from niod and it was disappointing ( the flavanone mud one - it's not on the website anymore, so it must have been d/c - the metal tube split and the brick red product went flying across my white bathroom...nice! had to throw it out - cs told me not to bother mailing anything in to return and to drive over 2 hours instead). at least i have the old faithful SA 2% mask in a plastic container. big ups to plastic.
I was so excited to use this product for my stubborn blackheads but did it help? Nope! It helped my mind rather than my skin. Pass, pass, pass! Save your money

Like many other have said, it's way too hard to squeeze the mask out of its tube. For the first use it worked fine but after that it hardened. If I wanted a workout I'd be at the gym, not buying skincare products.

I have been using this about 1x per week as a weekly exfoliant for about a year. I think it's effective and well priced. I do follow the directions and never leave on more than 10-12 minutes and sometimes skip weeks in dry months.

avis.titre: Seems like a regular charcoal masque
avis.texte: I don't have oily skin, so I use this once a week, sometimes every other week as a full mask. I use it more as a spot treatment masque for those stubborn hormonal pimples. It helps that out a little bit. Even though I don't have oily skin, when I use this masque on my entire face, it does not feel dry and extra tight when I rinse it off after ten mins. I hope TO will consider a hydrating masque!

avis.titre: Good for acne and oily skin
avis.texte: I have acne prone and oily skin. I use this mask twice a week and it helps with clearing the congestion on my nose and chin. I notice my skin is not as smooth if I do not use this mask at least once a week. It is not 100% acne prevention but it keeps my pores cleaner. I won't rebuy bc I see faster better results with leave on products. The consistency is like dried out toothpaste and you have to really squeeze it to get it out. The consistency is fine and has not separated on me. I do not recommend it for those with dry skin.
I love this product! It clears out my acne and I can even spot treat! So effective. Just be aware that because it's so potent you want to limit its use.

avis.titre: Great mask for sensitive, dry skin
avis.texte: Please read the label and do not use for more than 10 minutes or your face will be red.

avis.titre: First product to irritate my skin!
avis.texte: I have hardy skin. Nothing bothers it. This product caused my first reaction ever. Skin was raised, swollen and inflamed. Wherever the product was, that skin became horribly red and puffy.
I don't see a crazy difference since I started using many products from the ordinary but I'll give it a little bit more time and then see

I LOVE this product! It makes my skin feel super smooth after exfoliating. I use it twice a week and apply the ordinary morracan oil for my dry skin before going to bed and by the next morning it leaves my skin so soft and hydrated. Overall recommend this product and will continue to use!

I LOVE this masque and I rush to buy it again after I finish it every time. I have naturally oily skin, but during the harsh canadian winters, I have combination/dry skin. I try to use it 2x a week sometimes 3 depending on what's up with my skin at the moment. I highly recommend it for those of us ladies who get hormonal acne during, before or after your period. I put this masque on and the next day any acne I had is basically gone. I truly love it and will forever buy it, plus it's affordable.

I got this for Christmas and I have been using it for about a month and a half now. I use it about once a week and it has definitely improved the appearance of my clogged pores around the nose area. I usually extract the pores first then use it. I find that I don't have to extract as often and there is significantly less oil/ clogged up gunk when I do. I am happy this mask has worked so well, this is the key to less clogged pores. My only complaint is barely any product comes out when you squeeze the bottle. I have to push so hard to get just a little out. Other than that, I am impressed.

avis.titre: Best mask for black heads and pore control!
avis.texte: This Salicylic Acid mask is amazing! I like to put it primarily in the T-zone area and do a mixed mask on other parts of the face with their AHA/BHA red colored peeling solution. However, it is great for the whole face as well. Make sure to leave it on dry, clean skin for about 10-15 minutes and rinse with lukewarm or warm water. Using this once a week has dramatically reduced and ended my blackheads and size of my nose and t-zone pores especially. I recommend this mask as a great addition to a well rounded skin care routine and it last a long time and is so affordable too. It checks all the boxes and is way better for you than peel off masks and nose strips!
This mask smells so disgusting it's hard to use. It does work and help acne, but the smell is so awful I won't buy it again.

I noticed results after my second time using this product. I immediately noticed that more pores were smaller and my blackheads aren't as noticeable. I would say if you have sensitive skin use a small amount it did leave my face a little red but overall I am happy with this mask and will be purchasing it again.
Unless they mistakenly gave me a larger size this product is actually bigger than the description at 1.7 ounces and not 1 ounce so that was a pleasant surprise.

I use this mask about once a week or once every two weeks. It clears my skin so much. I've struggled with acne my whole life and I've never had a product work so well. Just make sure to follow the directions so your skin doesn't get dry. Love it tho.
Great stuff just don't use too often , overall leaves skin feeling refreshed and decongested
I use this for trouble areas like my chin or forehead. Or for individual blemishes. Works great and is gentle enough for my sensitive skin

leaves my skin so soft and glowy after i use it, i love salicylic acid as a skin care ingredient and this product is one i 110% recommend to anyone who is looking to try salicylic acid. it's non irritating and works great.

I have been a fan of the Ordinary's products for years and was excited to try this mask. Sadly, it is underwhelming. It is super difficult to get out of the tube, has a strange consistency like it has separated, and smells pretty funky. I'll use it, but I won't re-order.

I must say this was my hero product. I think the formula has changed and it is not as effective as previously. I can definitely see the difference compared to when I used to use it in the past. The bottle got bigger and the product got worse. Sad, but I will not be purchasing this anymore. I hope that the company isn't heading down the cost cutting route as that will just not pay off in the long term.

avis.titre: Great, but a few things to know!!
avis.texte: Overall, this has cleared my blackheads up well! It takes a few weeks of use to work so don't give up if you don't see results the first time you use it. Also, do not use this every day. Only use it 1-2 times a week or else your skin will dry out. I would say only use this on the oiliest parts of your skin (my T-zone is really oily and I only use it there) as this can be super drying everywhere else.
Always loved this mask! Helps keep your face clear and looking fresh. For me it helped with breakouts and black heads (as long as you use it twice a week). Highly recommend.

I am 40 years old and I have tried a bunch of masks. This is hands down the best I have every used. Longer you leave it on, better the result get. leaves you with a hydrated, smooth and radiant skin. Even feels a bit tighter :) I have used it two days in a row, 3 times this week, loving it so much. The Ordinary Team, you are killing it! thank you for making this, lets make it last. And yeah, try to make a bigger container please? Love Colette
Makes your pores look smaller and blackheads are non existent with consistent use. And not to mention a great price point! I've repurchased this for years now!!! Love love love!

avis.titre: Absolutely fell in love with it
avis.texte: I am going to buy this again and again this is one of the best hair products I can't wait for all my family to try this

avis.titre: The masque seems to have separated
avis.texte: I was really keen to try this product to help with the build up on my nose and t-zone. However, it appeared the product has separated and I don't know how to fix it. There is a lot of oiliness and then a big clump of the charcoal and rest of the ingredients. I have watched reviews and the masque comes out smooth and shiny black, mine I can barley squeeze out of the tube and it is matte and chunky. I am not sure if the prpduct is actually supposed to be like this or if mine is not right

I only use this in oiler areas of my face (t-zone) because that's where it's needed, and so I don't dry out the rest of my face (I live in a very high-dry climate). This masque is very effective. It cleanses the pores, tightens the skin, and brightens my face. I use it about once a week (twice at most) and it keeps my skin much more clear. I love the price, it's easy to use, and it works for me. I'd recommend it to anyone.

i struggled with many small bumps on my forehead & that made me insecure especially since i wear makeup a lot to cover my acne scars. i've tried salicylic acid facial cleansers and none of them helped. i bought this about 2 weeks ago, and only used it 3 times. i saw a major change after 2 days of the first use. all the bumps on my forehead were gone, for the price i thinks it's amazing. i have sensitive skin and this helped incredibly. apply hyaluronic acid after to hydrate your skin barrier. don't use on open skin, IT WILL BURN.
I've been using this for over a year. My face feels soft, pores tighter, and clean after using.

i love this stuff its great for oily skin i use it once a week on my nose and cheek for black heads and white heads. it's a very high concentration of SA so u have to be careful i only use a pea sized amount and spread it out as a very thin film and wash off no longer than 10 minutes

avis.titre: doesn't really work for my oily nose :(
avis.texte: i have a SUPERRR oily nose and the worst blackheads ever so i tried this product—ive had this product for about a month and have been using it once a week with little results. i recently started doing it twice a week (bottle instructions is 1-2 times a week) and still haven't seen anything. it's like it makes it less oily right after use but once it's the next morning it's oily all over again. ive heard it takes a while to start working so maybe it'll help within a few weeks and if so i'll update :/ but so far nothing!

avis.titre: Not for me, may work for others
avis.texte: I don't know what exact ingredient would cause it but after using this product, I had a lot of redness and irritation. My skin doesn't like this. I tried it once, then one more time a couple weeks later. I was surprised because I've used exfoliating products like salicylic acid before.

avis.titre: My favorite mask of all time
avis.texte: I cannot say enough. My pores, skin texture and blackheads were never the dame.after using this mask. I didn't realize it was black when I got it and the results are not as intense as the bha mask(which I love) but it is easier, safer and more comfortable to use. Love it!!
After research, salicylic acid helps to remove impurities from the pores. I tried it on my nose instead of using the pore strips and was surprised that it worked. Definitely worth the money.

I use this ad a spot treatment to clear up any blemishes that I have. I like this a lot and it really helps decongest my skin. I do have pretty sensitive skin and this does not leave my skin irritated. My skin has a minor about of flaking but I'll take that when I'm trying to clear up my blemishes.

Extremely oily and blemish-prone skin here. The mask is a bit drying, but nothing out of the ordinary as all other masks out there have that effect. One thing really bothered me: the smell. Fortunately, it's only supposed to be endured for 10 minutes 1—2 times a week.

I was breaking out pretty badly so I ran and got this, since I use a lot of this brand already and love them. Surprisingly I did see a pretty good difference after just one use. Also my skin felt soft and tight. Some people did say that this burns and there is a small burning sensation but not enough for me to not be able to leave it on. I would recommend
Love this masque. Very brightening. Just beware it is verrrryyy drying so make sure to moisturize super well after use!!
Wanted this to get rid of blackheads on my nose area, and it worked amazing after just one use. It has a kind of strong scent when first put on but it goes away quickly
Gets the job done, recommend to anyone that is dealing with acne/ texture skin. super affordable !
I did not expect this mask to be so black out of the bottle, but I really love it. My skin felt so soft after using it, but was not crying.
Been using for a week and I already see results in my skin and I struggle with acne.

i adore this masque- it's incredible. i suffer from hormonal acne due to *that time of month* and this helps control it!! i use it once a week and it helps clear my skin and it feels like it exfoliates it as well?!? just make sure u leave it on for 10 minutes at the MOST, i'd recommend starting out with 5 minutes and see what happens. i also recommend using a very hydrating serum, oil and moisturizer afterwards to help lock in the good stuff and prevent dry skin. i just wish they sold it in bigger tubes!!

Used it as directed, twice. Made me break out and my skin really irritated for days after. I'm sad it didn't work for me and do really understand why since I typically use salicylic acid on my face at night. Too bad, I had high hopes. Use with caution.

I have dry, acne prone, very rough skin and it helps so much. i mainly use it on my nose/ t zone area and it helps minimize blackheads and white heads. It also helps with my rough skin and makes it so smooth!

2 year user here and I would definitely recommend for acne prone skin. have a angry breakout? slap a thin layer of this on (sometimes I'll use as a spot treatment overnight; DONT DO WHAT I DO lol) , and see everything diminish in size, redness and overall oiliness. it's a staple in my regimen.
This zapped my monthly breakout just by following the instructions. It didn't completely dry out my sensitive skin. Great product!
shrinked my closed comedones and doesn't burn or irritate my skin

I was skeptical about using this but I've already purchased like 4 of these bottles and that says a lot. Other masks with salicylic acid have ruined my skin but THIS mask has saved it!! I love it and will keep purchasing it!! Super happy with the results it gives me and has boosted my confidence because of how great my skin looks now!
I have blackheads on my nose. I tried this product hoping it would help. I swear it made it worst.

I've used this mask three times over two weeks to give it a proper try but it just made my skin breakout all over. Before using it I didn't have any breakouts, just texture and clogged pores but I had decided to get the balance set since I already used all the products in it and the mask was the only new one I had not tried. I don't know if maybe it's just not right for myself, I have an oily/combination skin but now that my skin is breaking out I'm just hoping that it will calm down soon.

I've had good results when I use this mask as directed I.e once a week. I beleive is has helped reduce the appearance of my acne scarring on my cheeks & jawline. It also leaves my skin feeling smooth and exfoliated but not overly so which I find to happen, particularly with physical exfoliant products. This is a skin friendlier option. Only thing is the smaller size runs out quite quickly, it would be cool to have a size even bigger than the big size haha
I love this product. After 10 minutes I rinse and, voila, smooth, firm perfect skin!

I haven't used it for too long yet, but it makes my skin feel good so far. The only thing -- it kind of smells really bad. Not so bad that i can't use it, but bad enough that while im using it im like, "wow, this smells pretty bad." I guess that's good in a way because it means they didn't add unnecessary fragrance but... yeah. would still recommend though!

I've spent the last two years trying to combat acne all over my chin as a result of wearing a mask all day in retail. Never had bad acne before and was at my wits end, it was so painful and covering my lower face. I used a lot of other salicylic acid products as well as other active ingredients meant to help clear acne and nothing worked for so long. Doing this mask twice a week has completely cleared my chin and made the rest of my face feel so soft and healthy. Probably won't work for everyone obviously but I would really recommend trying. I'm always going to have this in my routine now.

avis.titre: I love this product, definitely would buy again
avis.texte: This skin care mask works so well the very first time I put the mask on I did it wrong and it still helped my skin so quickly. I definitely recommend this product.
Easy to use and the skin appears smooth and without imperfections

i have dry sensitive skin so i did notice some irritation, but it was pretty minimal. that aside i hot this for my pores on my nose and didn't notice any improvement. i think it just wasn't right for me.

I bought this in the beginning of the year and tried it twice - unfortunately it absolutely did not work for me and made me break out all over (both times). My skin feels really sensitive days after I've used it. I actually really love products by the ordinary but this just was not made for me I guess.
When I use this my face is red/pink when I take it off, almost like sun burn as it's exactly where the product was. It doesn't hurt and lasts a couple of hours before wearing off. Is this normal?
I have been on the balancing set for a month now and after a few weeks of purging (normal) my face looks great and getting better. The mask feels great.

I think i've bought four different tubes of this mask. It's a really great mask for when my skin need a deep cleanse. I can not use it more than once a week as it can dry out my skin, and i also know that after use my skin can be a bit red and sensitive, even the day after. But in the long run it really helps to keep the skin clear. I just know i'm not going to love my skin the day just after, so i plan accordingly. I wish it would be a bit less strong for my acne prone but sensitive skin, but it's still a really efficient mask.

I've used this once a week for about one month and I've notice my pores have significantly diminished… especially the ones on my nose! The 50mL comes a long way as it has lasted longer than I thought. I recommended the product:)

My holy grail! Use it once a week to heal my breakouts! Notices less bog huge pimples with it. It can dry out the skin so best to limit use to once a week. I follow up with a light moisturiser after use.
This is a monthly solution for me! It's so funny because i'm a black woman and I go in black face for 1 month to fight monthly acne..

After one use my skin became extremely irritated and the next day I had hives that were located just where I put the product. I listened to all the instructions and even only left the mask on for five minutes. Please don't buy ):
I've never had sensitive skin but for some reason my skin reacts so bad when I put this mask on. I apply on my clean face and leave it on for maybe a minute or two and it's already burning.

I have been using this mask religiously for over a year. I recently bought the larger container of this and it feels different going on. Feels greasy. Has anything changed ingredient wise…it doesn't seem to have based on the ingredient list. Matches what's on the smaller container. Skin has been great up until starting using the larger container that just feels like it contains something different.

I would agree with one reviewer. I didn't hate it but didn't love it. Part of my frustration is that it is difficult to get the product out. You don't need a lot, but if I can't even get out what I need, that's a problem. I think if would be better if it came in a jar.

I tried this for the first time, it got rid of some acne. But around the third week of using it, it started to make me get a few pimples. The mask made the pimples dry up as I continue to use it throughout the week. It works great but at the same it doesn't work.
I'm 53, dry skin but wanted to try this. My skin looks beautiful and feels so smooth. I doubt I'll use it more than once a week but I use the peel once or twice a week and it is a great routine.
Very effective in cleaning blackheads but if you forget to close the lid properly for once, It will dry and clump like black marshmallow texture which is not good.

avis.titre: I'm not sure if I'd buy this product again.
avis.texte: I'm going to give this products a few more trys but so far I'm not liking the results.

I bought this product before seeing a few negative reviews, and ended up loving it previous to seeing the other opinions. I still stand by loving this product as a less frequent exfoliation stage. This isn't a normal clay mask, this is a once a week exfoliant for me. It's a little hard to remove but nothing to crazy.

i used it 1 time for 2 weeks. the first time, the day after i used it i had a mini break out, but it wasnt that bad. the second was even worse, i now have huuuge pimples all over my face and it is horrible. might be just a coincidence or something but i didnt like it.

avis.titre: I am in love with this mask
avis.texte: My skin has cleared up so much with this! I also have really sensitive skin & this did not dry me out. If you're thinking about getting this, I 100% say do it! It continually leaves my skin so soft and clear. I LOVE it.

I love this mask! I actually bought it a while ago and didn't really use it but since suffering from acne which has left me with an irregular skin texture and hyperpigmentation I've found that this mask is a holy grail for a flare up. I use this maybe once every two weeks when my skin is feeling bumpy and rough. I feel that it does a great job of smoothing my skin, it always feels so soft afterwards and the salicylic acid always helps with any pesky spots that are starting to flare up. I like that it's not super harsh and when you wash it off it becomes a little grainy so you can get a good scrub. Add this into your routine for softer and less angry skin!

got this for my partner who has post acne Indian skin. he doesn't use it that often so I started using it on my very rare breakouts. It's FANTASTIC. it's also fantastic on his skin, leaving it soft and much much less red. this is the business of a product, yet a bit hard to squeeze out the tube but you really do not need to lard it on like a thick layer, just a very thin layer is enough. another great product from The Ordinary. thanks. still fan grrrrling.

Love this product & use it weekly! No other mask I have tried visibly clears up pores and blackheads like this one. When I stopped using it for a month or so, I noticed my skin had lots of tiny bumps on my forehead, texture, and blackheads on my nose. Not to mention how long the tube lasts!

I have had painful cystic acne since I was almost 12 years old and have tried numerous topical creams and masks. However, after being on Epuris for two years, my skin was still not to the point where I felt good about myself until I started using this mask. This mask is so easy to throw on after waking up quickly, and I noticed an improvement in my skin after only a few uses, which is much faster than most products I have ever tried! If you feel like your skin is unfixable, please try this mask!!
Cleans out pores so good! But doesn't leave my face feeling dry! This is the first product I tried where I can visibly see my pores are cleaner! I am very impressed!

avis.titre: Love the product, but packaging could be better
avis.texte: I immediately noticed reduced redness. The next morning, my active pimples seem smaller and my pores seem cleaner. Sadly, when I opened it the first time, the plastic stopper was broken or broke. I got the larger bottle because I had a feeling I would like the product, but the product might just dry out before I finish it. Also, I agree with other reviewers that it is pretty difficulty to squeeze out the product.

This mask is PERFECT in quality and price. I love how it makes my skin feel afterwards- SOOO smooth and refreshed. I use it about once a week on days my skin is especially bad and the next morning I SEE the difference- less redness and breakout, and an even skin tone! After I wash off the mask, there tends to be a red line on my forehead around where the mask ends, but it goes away by the next morning. I definitely recommend using a moisturizer after because the clay + acid combo is somewhat drying even for experienced users of salicylic acid. I love using the ordinary's natural moisturizing factors + HA after.
I used it the first time and it stung a lot! But then I started to use once a month, and it indeed gets rid of blackheads. However, your skin will gradually become

while I'm not a routine user of this mask I do like to break it out about that time of the month when my face starts producing too much oil and I get a few breakouts. the SA clears my face quickly while the clay absorbs the excess oil in my skin. I use pretty sparingly and a tube last me one yr.

avis.titre: Didn't love it. Didn't hate it.
avis.texte: It's a good facial mask, does help clear some blackheads. Didn't fall in love with the product. Probably wouldn't buy again :/

When masking I try to only use a very thin layer of product but this is the thickest mask I've ever used by far. It comes out of the bottle in globs, not very easy to apply. Other than that this didn't work for my sensitive skin either, it was irritating and left my skin all red; even though I've used many BHA products in the past. Despite this, I wouldn't say it's a bad product. It works fine for my husband's oily skin. But I wouldn't recommend this because there are better masks out there, and salicylic acid is a common ingredient you can find in most of them.

The Ordinary has become my favourite line, and it is the most effective, yet this product didn't live up to expectations. Before ordering it, I knew it would not be as good the BHA serum, but it was worse. Used it twice. Both times my skin dried out and became flaky. There was never a problem with the BHA serum. Why did you discontinue it? Luckily there are other manufacturers who still produce similar.
Love this masque. It cleans pores and has a cooling effect that feels fresh and clean.

I am no stranger to salicylic acid or any other acid for that matter so I was surprised use this masque and experiencing discomfort. I made sure to haul all other exfoliating treatments prior to use. Not really sure what the issue is, asi have never had a negative reaction to an ordinary product before. Aside from the burning sensation, I have used this product twice and have been uncomfortable so needless, to say, I can't claim it had any benefits for my skin. I bought the 100ml sizethinking I would love it and want more as with my other tried and true Ordinary products but man, this was a major disappointment. From now on, I won't be buying bigger sizes if I haven't tried the product before. Otherwise, i have been very happy with The myriad of of products I have purchased over the last 5+ years.
On my second tube, so glad they're selling it in a bigger size but they could have made it bigger! I like to use this once a week, it does clean out my filthy pores.
I previously used charcoal strips on my nose and it didn't remove the black spots, I used this mask and they disappeared! Amazing product.
This is by far my favourite product of this brand. If you want to tackle stubborn blackheads, this is for you. I go through this product often and love the new larger size.

For a couple of months my skin has been very dry with incredibly rough surface. Back in September it crackled even and was bleeding a bit. No cream or serum could be absorbed. They made things even worse, all my trusty ordinary & hylamide products didn't work how they used to. I couldn't do anything about the rough surface of the skin. Plus the skin was so sensible to everything - it itched and burned. Well this masque is a miracle. Directly after first use, so after 10 minutes and rinsing, the redness was almost gone. The skin was smooth!! And buffet was immediately absorbed! Really, I couldn't believe it. So now, by using this masque and slowly hydrating my skin I wait until the skin is healed completely. This couldn't have been possible without this masque. And even on my complicated skin the masque did not burn at all :) thank you, Deciem! Very happy you are around))))

My second time using it, it will strip ur skin if u have sensitive skin/naturally dry skin already. Moisturize right after, It was still irritated after moisturizer. Overrall my blackheads are getting cleaned out lol just becarful
I have very textured skin and this has really helped a lot! My best skin days are always the day after I use this mask. I was worried it would dry out my skin but it doesn't at all! It's the best!

I've tried this a few times now and all it seems to do is stain my sebaceous filaments a darker black. No improvement in skin texture or brightness. Also stains any facecloths but less bothered about that.
Again such a great product.. Using this 2 times a week and after the first week no break outs and clear smooth skin

I have hormonal acne and and am irritated by most masks due to fragrances. This is perfect for me, and leaves my face feeling exfoliated and renewed. Especially for the price, I definitely recommend it to those who can withstand acid exfoliants.
there was a massive tube and the bottle had next to no product in it. it was literally almost empty after my second use and i was applying a thin layer too. weird

I bought and used this today for the first time and it's already a favorite product. I've been wearing makeup more frequently and for longer hours, because of this my face has become very congested and with occasional painful cystic acne. I used this mask earlier today before putting on a full face of makeup that I then wore for 6 hours. My expectations were pretty low and assumed I'd need to use this mask several times over the next few weeks before seeing any significant results. Was I ever wrong! Tonight when I took off my makeup I was amazed by how much my skin had cleared up. My nose had been packed with blackheads, but is now almost entirely clear! My cheeks, chin, all of my face has vastly improved. Even the one big, deep zit is greatly improved and I now expect it to heal a lot sooner than before. My only warning—not significant enough to call a complaint—is that this mask really dried out my skin. I followed it with a heavy moisturizer, but my skin was still very dried out. Not a big deal now that I know to expect it and plan ahead.

avis.titre: Prepare yourself for a confidence overload
avis.texte: The devil may work hard and Kris Jenner may work harder, but this salicylic acid mask works the HARDEST. Every single time I use this mask I wake up as a goddess. Don't believe the witchcraft voodoo magic this stuff is capable of? I used this mask the night before having to meet up with my ex to pick up some stuff from his place and OF COURSE my face had decided to explode with stress breakouts. When I tell you I woke up with the freshest face -- 90% of the breakouts were gone, the other 10% barely discernible, my forehead somehow looked like I had gotten bot0x in my sleep, my skin looked RADIANT. I walked into that man's apartment to snatch up my belongings feeling like the QUEEN I am, confidence was radiating out of my pores. To relive that moment again, I would gladly pay about 100x more than this mask sells for. Just do yourself a favor and get this, even if you use it as just a spot treatment, it works wonders. I use it on any breakouts I get on my chest from working out and it puts those zits to rest real quick too. But with great power comes great responsibility. Follow the directions and play by the rules and you'll be fine, but go past 10 minutes, push through any burning feeling if it comes up, get this stuff too close to your eyes or rub your eyes while you're rinsing it off will all lead to less than positive outcomes. I learned that the hard way when I woke up with semi-swollen eyes after aggressively rubbing my eyes while rinsing this off. I find it best to wipe

I use it once a week and try not to put on too much - less is more!! No problem with the tube other than I sometimes squeeze out too much and although a thick black layer seems fun it is wasteful and a thin layer works better and is easier to rinse off. Started off with seven minutes, now leave on for ten. The dermatologists, Doctorly, (look them up) recommend this product and so do I. Great price point and an effective exfoliating masque to cleanse pores and clear up blackheads. I have recommended it to friends and they love it too.
i saw so many good reviews for this but it didn't work at all :(

I've been using this product along with many other Ordinary serums and it's great! I use it once a week and on other days Lactic acid. Amazing! I suggest you put it on 10 mins before a shower. It's easier to wash off that way!
Every time I use this product it makes me break out. Not for me .
Very light mask…draws out pimples quickly! Just wish there was more product in the tube…doesn't dry out my skin!
Skin feels soft, smooth and good pore reduction. Use one a week, swapping between this and a demo abrasion exfoliant. I'm 44.
my skin was so soft after I used it and my pores looked so clean!! im absolutely obsessed.

this masque really helped with my acne. I wear a mask everyday at work for 8 hours and after using this with the other ordinary products, it helped with my skin. controlled my oil, smoothed my skin and noticed that my acne disappeared after a couple uses. Definitely recommend!
This product made my skin feels so much smoother and it helped me to fight against blackheads ! I definitely recommend this product.

avis.titre: The best exfoliator for my skin
avis.texte: First of all: I have combination and sensitive skin, with a lot of blemishes (never had acne), black heads, and redness. I tried chemical exfoliators for the first time 2 years ago. The Ordinary AHA + BHA Peeling Solution gave me irritation and redness, even when I used it carefully. It was just not the right one for my skin. But this one...this one is really my thing! Helped me a lot with my stubborn black heads and uneven tone. The skin feels smooth and soft the next day. I used it with the niacinamide serum and the natural moisturising factors cream, as the guideline suggested. The results were amazing, I never felt a skincare regimen more suitable for me. Obviously you have to wear sunscreen while using this product. My only concern is the fact that the product expires in 6 months after opening it. I would really like to purchase che 100ml one, but i know i won't be albe to use and finish it in 6 months (i finished the 50ml one in 5 months).

avis.titre: Feels nice but not worth the money
avis.texte: I've had this for about a week and my skin feels soft after I use it. It hasn't been long enough to notice any big improvements to my skin. I don't think I'd buy it again because the price. It isn't too pricey overall, but for what's in it I don't think it's worth it. I used it about 3 times and feel like half the bottle is gone already

avis.titre: Game changer for acne prone skin
avis.texte: I've been trying to get clear skins for 2 years now(my birth control has hormones which ruined my skin) and nothing worked as good as this! I'm actually seeing my skin clear up. 10/10

avis.titre: Perfect for ingrown hair after shaving!
avis.texte: I wish there were and even bigger value package. 500ml? I feel a huge difference applying it the next hours after shaving! leaving it on skin before going to shower and rinsing it off at the end. my acne has diminish significantly because it was mostly caused by ingrown hair. I feel this product is perfect for male skin as it tends to be thicker and most products feel like they go too light on acid strength. it is same 2% strength but it feels like the product does really soak in. And I have tried leaving on those face washes with 2% and it is just not the same. note that having a beard makes any product use more expensive as we tend to use more on days between shaving.

Wow, I can't recommend this product enough. I saw a reduction in blackheads and general breakouts after the second use! It's a little messy but not hard to clear up, so not the end of the world. I've tried many acne products before but this is truly wonderful. I doubt I could live without it anymore!! Plus they've added a larger size... I'm over the moon. As always thank you ordinary!

This product along side some other ordinary products I use are my holy grail. With some masks you have to use it a few time in order to notice some improvement but with this mask the first night I used it and the morning after I notice a difference right away!!! I have also noticed that it works well with my Lactic acid (not in the same routine of course) HIGHLY recommend.

avis.titre: Eagerly awaiting the drops to be back!
avis.texte: After ten minutes, I tried to rinse the masque off... it was very hard to remove and left some pimples on my face raw from rubbing it off. So in the end, it likely made the impurities stick around longer rather than the intended use of getting rid of them. I haven't had such a reaction to any other face masks that I have tried in the past.

Mask has been a game changer for my maskacne breakouts! The Ordinary never lets me down, high quality product, powerful ingredients at a ridiculous value. I have been using this brand for over a decade and always love trying their new products. This mask works really well with diminishing my pores on my T-zone and chin. I use it as a masque 3x a week now that it's summer. It's a fantastic spot treatment for sudden breakouts, but make sure to do a batch test first and follow the instructions, as this is a powerful mask. If you want poreless, glowing skin, add this to your skin regimen!
